006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.MetaschemaConstants;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint.IFeatureModelConstrained;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.util.ModuleUtils;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
012
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
015
016public interface IAssemblyDefinition
017    extends IModelDefinition, IContainerModelAssembly, IAssembly, IFeatureModelConstrained {
018  IEnhancedQName MODEL_QNAME = IEnhancedQName.of(MetaschemaConstants.METASCHEMA_NAMESPACE, "model");
019
020  /**
021   * Check if the assembly is a top-level root assembly.
022   *
023   * @return {@code true} if the assembly is a top-level root, or {@code false}
024   *         otherwise
025   */
026  default boolean isRoot() {
027    // not a root by default
028    return false;
029  }
030
031  /**
032   * Get the root name if this assembly is a top-level root.
033   *
034   * @return the root name if this assembly is a top-level root, or {@code null}
035   *         otherwise
036   */
037  @Nullable
038  default String getRootName() {
039    // not a root by default
040    return null;
041  }
042
043  /**
044   * Get the root index to use for binary data, if this assembly is a top-level
045   * root.
046   *
047   * @return the root index if provided and this assembly is a top-level root, or
048   *         {@code null} otherwise
049   */
050  @Nullable
051  default Integer getRootIndex() {
052    // not a root by default
053    return null;
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Get the XML qualified name to use in XML as the root element.
058   *
059   * @return the root XML qualified name if this assembly is a top-level root, or
060   *         {@code null} otherwise
061   */
062  default IEnhancedQName getRootQName() {
063    IEnhancedQName retval = null;
064    String rootName = getRootName();
065    if (rootName != null) {
066      retval = ModuleUtils.parseModelName(getContainingModule(), rootName);
067    }
068    return retval;
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Get the name used for the associated property in JSON/YAML.
073   *
074   * @return the root JSON property name if this assembly is a top-level root, or
075   *         {@code null} otherwise
076   */
077  default String getRootJsonName() {
078    return getRootName();
079  }
080
081  @Override
082  default boolean isInline() {
083    // not inline by default
084    return false;
085  }
086
087  @Override
088  default IAssemblyInstance getInlineInstance() {
089    // not inline by default
090    return null;
091  }
092
093  @Override
094  default IAssemblyDefinition getOwningDefinition() {
095    return this;
096  }
097  //
098  // @Override
099  // default IAssemblyNodeItem getNodeItem() {
100  // return null;
101  // }
102
103  @Override
104  default boolean hasChildren() {
105    return IModelDefinition.super.hasChildren() || IContainerModelAssembly.super.hasChildren();
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * A visitor callback.
110   *
111   * @param <CONTEXT>
112   *          the type of the context parameter
113   * @param <RESULT>
114   *          the type of the visitor result
115   * @param visitor
116   *          the calling visitor
117   * @param context
118   *          a parameter used to pass contextual information between visitors
119   * @return the visitor result
120   */
121  @Override
122  default <CONTEXT, RESULT> RESULT accept(@NonNull IModelElementVisitor<CONTEXT, RESULT> visitor, CONTEXT context) {
123    return visitor.visitAssemblyDefinition(this, context);
124  }
125}
